notes: Seed URL is the tax office page; the Elections page is https://www.angelinacounty.net/elections/. Its 'Election Results' section links only 2024 primary runoff and constable files and a 'Partial Manual Count 11.05.24'; nothing for the 2024 general, 2026 primary or 2026 runoff. One web search found 'Angelina County Election Results' at election.angelinacounty.net, a county-built live results app ('Live election results for Angelina County, Texas'). Its public API api/results.php returns only the active election (id 6, 'November 3 2026 General', all zero votes); the data model has per-candidate county 'votes' plus 'precincts_counted'/'precincts_total' and no per-precinct vote fields, which suggests county totals only, but which past elections it carried is not shown, so it cannot decide any target election (earlier election IDs were not probed). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-C): no election changed. New lead for 2026_primary: web search located unlinked county files https://www.angelinacounty.net/files/pdf/elections/pdf/2026/030326/unofficial.results.rep.030326.pdf (hash 72f537fa...) and unofficial.results.dem.030326.pdf (hash 8a56dd25...): 'Summary Results Report ... UNOFFICIAL RESULTS ... TX Angelina County 260303 Primary ... 21 of 21 ED', county totals with Absentee, Early Voting and Election Day columns, footer 'Election Summary - 03/03/2026 10:05 PM'. Last-Modified Mon, 09 Mar 2026 13:15 GMT (scanned with Adobe Paper Capture, ModDate the same), so the upload is after election night. This is a county-totals file with an election-night printed time, but no record shows what else was posted that night (the Elections page no longer lists any 2026 primary results), so the rule 43 condition 'no election-day precinct numbers that night' cannot be shown and the election stays UNDETERMINED (lead toward LATER). The live app's JavaScript (election.angelinacounty.net/dist/assets/index-iFlIcbgw.js, hash c2ab007f...) confirms its data model holds county-level candidate votes plus precincts_counted/precincts_total only (endpoints results.php, elections.php, candidates.php, propositions.php; no per-precinct votes), but when the app was first used is not shown. 2026_runoff: a web search found only official reconciliation files in /2026/052626/; no unofficial runoff file. 2024_general: nothing new. Wayback harvest for angelinacounty.net (domain match) found no election-night captures. Sweep pending.
tag_rationale: All three elections are UNDETERMINED (no surviving election-night files and no update history for the live app), so by rule the tag is UNKNOWN.

2024_general.fact: County Elections page lists no 2024 general results (only 'View Partial Manual Count' for 11.05.24). Live app shows only the Nov 3 2026 election. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: No 2026 primary results on the county Elections page; the live app API returns only the active Nov 3 2026 election. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: No 2026 runoff results on the county Elections page; the live app API returns only the active Nov 3 2026 election. Check 3 pending.
